notes: Each option in the 1-, 2- and 3-Advantage rows may be bought with one Triumph instead of the listed Advantage.
Options in the Triumph rows need Triumph itself: one or two Triumph as recorded; Advantage cannot buy them.
Combat rules beside the table: one Triumph can trigger a Critical Injury whatever the Critical rating, or one quality whatever its Advantage cost (EotE 205, AoR 218, FaD 211).
The acting player normally chooses how Advantage and Triumph are spent unless the GM has good cause to decide instead (EotE 205, AoR 217, FaD 211).
All three books present the list as common examples, not a closed list; other uses agreed by GM and players are allowed.

sources.book: Edge of The Empire - Core Book

notes: Each option in the 1-, 2- and 3-Threat rows may be triggered by one Despair instead of the listed Threat.
Options in the Despair row need Despair itself.
The GM normally spends Threat and Despair, and may hand that choice to players, for example on NPC checks (EotE 205, AoR 218, FaD 211).
Options and costs match in all three cores; only Edge adds a repeatable note to the strain option, plus minor wording and cross-reference page changes.

sources.book: Edge of The Empire - Core Book

notes: Each option in the 1-, 2- and 3-Advantage rows may be bought with one Triumph instead of the listed Advantage.
Options in the Triumph rows need Triumph itself: one or two Triumph as recorded.
Vehicle rules beside the table: one Triumph can trigger a Critical Hit whatever the weapon's Critical rating, or one weapon quality whatever its Advantage cost (EotE 235, AoR 250, FaD 243).
No strain-recovery row: system strain cannot be recovered by spending Advantage (EotE 225, AoR 237, FaD 231).
Options and costs match in all three cores; table number is 7-5 in Edge but 7-6 in AoR and FaD.
